title: Episode 16: Special Guest - Ray Reyes
description: 🎙️Out of Band is back with a special interview episode featuring Ray Reyes, Principal Security Lead at Engage Squared, ex‑Microsoft Security Lead, and #1 author of Mastering Microsoft Purview Deployment in the Era of AI. With over two decades of experience in cybersecurity, Ray has been at the forefront of shaping how organisations adopt and operationalise Microsoft Security technologies across Purview, Defender XDR, and beyond.In this episode, we sit down with Ray to explore his journey from Microsoft to Engage Squared, his insights on building security practices that actually deliver outcomes, and his perspective on the evolving landscape of data security, compliance, and AI governance.In this episode:✨ Ray’s career journey from Microsoft Security Lead to Principal Security Lead at Engage Squared✨ Why Purview is central to modern data security and compliance strategies✨ Defender XDR in practice: what organisations get right and wrong✨ Lessons from authoring the #1 Purview book and how it equips practitioners✨ Building sustainable security practices that go beyond feature deployment✨ The future of AI agents, governance, and what’s next in Microsoft SecurityWhether you are a SecOps professional, architecting cloud security, or simply want to hear from one of the most respected voices in Microsoft Security, this episode is packed with insights and practical takeaways.---🔵Follow us on our Socials:🔗LinkedInhttps://www.linkedin.com/company/oobcasts---🔵Meet and connect with our hosts:🔗Andrew 'Abe' O'Younghttps://linktr.ee/andrewoyoung🔗Anthony 'Anto' Porterhttps://linktr.ee/antoporter🔗Mathew Clarkhttps://linktr.ee/mathewclark

title: Episode 15: MDASH & Project Silica
description: 🎙️Out of Band is back with a big episode covering some of the most interesting developments in the Microsoft security world. We also look ahead at what is coming next across the ecosystem.In this episode:✨ Project Silica and why it matters for long term, resilient storage✨ MDASH and how multi model agentic security is shifting the landscape✨ The Global Security Community announcement and upcoming events✨ What is new in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Agent365✨ What we are watching next in Microsoft SecurityWhether you work in SecOps, manage devices in Intune, build cloud architecture, or just enjoy hearing practitioners break down what matters without the fluff, this episode has plenty to explore.---🔵Follow us on our Socials:🔗LinkedInhttps://www.linkedin.com/company/oobcasts---🔵Meet and connect with our hosts:🔗Andrew 'Abe' O'Younghttps://linktr.ee/andrewoyoung🔗Anthony 'Anto' Porterhttps://linktr.ee/antoporter🔗Mathew Clarkhttps://linktr.ee/mathewclark

title: Episode 04: Chronicles of a Rogue Device
description:
BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) is always a double-edged sword, and if you allow it in your organization, you have to do it right. By keeping that theme across the whole discussion, we discuss Conditional Access Policies and how you can protect BYO Devices with them by providing that first line of defense and during other activities. We also dive deep into Conditional Access Policies in general on how to get started and map it with the scenarios and how to keep on improving them to keep up with Zero-Trust.
